guard_streams.source: Bulletin: BDUK Delivery Performance, annual: April 2025 to March 2026

facts.detail: BDUK published the annual official statistics on 11 June 2026.
BDUK estimated 192,570 premises delivered in 2025/26, 28% more than the previous financial year.
Cumulative BDUK-subsidised gigabit-capable coverage reached 1,418,410 premises.
GIS contracts accounted for 72% of annual delivery, equal to 139,490 premises.
Rural areas accounted for 90% of delivery, equal to 173,190 premises.

guard_streams.source: Quality and Methodology Information for BDUK Delivery Performance, annual: April 2025 to March 2026

facts.detail: BDUK published the annual QMI on 11 June 2026.
The QMI is intended to explain data quality, methods, strengths and limitations.
Geographic inputs include ONS, NISRA, Scottish Government and AddressBase Premium data.
BDUK uses recent Ofcom premises- and postcode-level Connected Nations data.
Each release bulletin lists the versions of source datasets used.

guard_streams.source: Project Gigabit National Rolling Open Market Review May 2026

facts.detail: BDUK opened the May 2026 National Rolling Open Market Review on 1 May 2026.
The consultation outcome was updated with a closure notice on 1 June 2026.
BDUK states the National Rolling OMR takes place three times a year, in January, May and September.
The review seeks supplier information on current gigabit infrastructure and plans for the next three years.
The review is a planning and market-information process, not proof of current service at a selected parcel.

facts.detail: BDUK commissioned Ipsos UK and partners to evaluate Project Gigabit.
The evaluation covers both GIS contracts and the Gigabit Broadband Voucher Scheme.
Project Gigabit is a government-funded programme for hard-to-reach communities.
The programme targets homes and businesses not included in suppliers' commercial plans.
The plan recommends evaluation methods; it is not a source of current parcel-level availability.

facts.detail: BDUK first published the Project Gigabit contract-report collection on 24 October 2025.
The collection was last updated on 20 July 2026.
BDUK releases monthly updates of contracted and built premises for each Project Gigabit contract.
The July 2026 contract update was added on 20 July 2026.
The collection describes Project Gigabit as supporting hard-to-reach communities.
